verdict.rationale: Official docs state Omarchy (via 'Omarchy Quattro') can be installed to a single partition alongside Windows or other OS installations, directly supporting dual-boot setup, and a community comment reflects real intent to dual-boot it on a work laptop. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the dual-boot install process works smoothly end-to-end, and more detailed documentation of the dual-boot setup steps beyond a single line.
